name: ptModifyPart
signature: export function ptModifyPart(power: ValueExpr, toughness: ValueExpr, ctx: AbilityContext): EffectPart
contract: Returns exactly one EffectPart at sublayer 7c with a modify-pt modification.

Both values are evaluated to plain numbers here. layers.ts has its own DynamicValue for per-object recomputation and nothing the compiler emits needs it; reaching for it speculatively would add a second place a number can be wrong.
Negative values are passed through unchanged: minus three on both sides is a legal pump.

assertions.given: a count expression over two creatures

unlocks.source: supporting primitive for P01; its cards are counted once, on P01
